en.title: North Korea's Kim oversaw launch of missile that uses AI
en.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un supervised the test of a missile equipped with artificial intelligence technology designed to alter its flight path at low altitude, according to state media reports. The weapon reportedly traveled over 700 kilometers during the launch from the country's eastern coast.
